core_principle: Trade continuation when price escapes a defined session range with sustained volatility and acceptance.
event_requirements: Stronger breakoutScore increases probability of valid expansion.
Breakout intensity should dominate over sweep intensity.
acceptance_logic: acceptanceTime should indicate sustained trading beyond the breakout level.
Low acceptanceTime suggests potential false breakout.
Continuation probability increases as acceptance persists.
regime_preferences: Most effective early London session (09:00–11:00 Zurich time).
Also valid during NY open (14:30–16:00 Zurich time) when volatility expands.
Less reliable during low-volatility Asia session.
structure_considerations: Structure alignment strengthens continuation probability but is not mandatory.
Breakouts aligned with existing trend have higher continuation odds.
Breakouts against strong higher timeframe structure require stronger momentum.
entry_logic: Trade in the direction of the breakout.
Enter when momentum and volatility expansion are visible.
Avoid trading if breakout lacks conviction or follow-through.
stop_loss_guidelines: Place stop beyond the breakout level or recent structural boundary.
Allow room based on ATR_5m to avoid premature exit.
Avoid overly tight stops inside the prior range.
take_profit_guidelines: Target continuation beyond recent structural highs or lows.
Stronger expansion allows more extended targets.
risk_management: Increase risk when breakoutScore and acceptanceTime both support continuation.
Reduce risk if expansion is moderate or structure is unclear.
If breakout lacks sustained acceptance, prefer WAIT.
probabilistic_note: Not all conditions must be perfectly satisfied. The strategy is valid when volatility expansion and sustained acceptance beyond the session boundary indicate a higher probability of continuation.
